preconditions.description: n, d, and k are integers within the specified range.

postconditions.description: If the output is 'NO', there should be no additional lines. If the output is 'YES', there should be n lines following it.

postconditions.expression: stdout.startswith('YES\n') implies all(1 <= int(edge.split()[0]) <= n and 1 <= int(edge.split()[1]) <= n for edge in stdout.split('\n')[1:])
postconditions.description: All edges must connect vertices within the range [1, n].
There must be exactly n - 1 unique edges.

postconditions.expression: stdout.startswith('YES\n') implies all(int(edge.split()[0]) != int(edge.split()[1]) for edge in stdout.split('\n')[1:])
postconditions.description: No edge should connect a vertex to itself.

postconditions.expression: stdout.startswith('YES\n') implies all(diameter(tree) == d for tree in possible_trees(n, d, k))
postconditions.description: The constructed tree must have a diameter of d.

postconditions.expression: stdout.startswith('YES\n') implies all(degree(vertex, tree) <= k for vertex in range(1, n + 1) for tree in possible_trees(n, d, k))
postconditions.description: Each vertex in the constructed tree must have a degree of at most k.
